description.narrative: Removal of redioactive sources from well deposit

sector.narrative: Nuclear energy electric power plants and nuclear safety

description.narrative: There are around half a million disused radioactive sources throughout Ukraine. Under the long-term programme of the G7 Global Partnership donors, all these sources are to be moved to the newly built central repository, VEKTOR, located in the Chernobyl exclusion zone. After completion of the feasibility study which determines recommendations for the optimal solutions for the well-type storages, SSM has signed in November 2016 a new contract with SC Radon on a pilot project concerning detailed design for removal of the disused radioactive sources from a representative well-type storage at the Kiev Radon site. In 2017 two progress reports have been delivered, additional radiological investigation of the pilot well storage have been performed to evaluate the risks for design of adequate radiation protection and technical specifications for a container to be used for the transports of the sources from the pilot well storage have been determined.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
